test_title: PYST 1: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error’.

Restoring soil health would help at mitigate the effects of climate change.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **"help at mitigate the".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In English, the** correct structure** is **"help (to) do something**", **not*** "help at do something".*
